enabled.description: Enable or disable the RabbitMQ topology bootstrap job. The Job applies exchanges, queues and bindings inside the default vhost "/"; it does not create the application broker user or its permissions.

skipTlsVerify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification on the management API calls. Leave false (verify) whenever protocol is https: the Job sends the broker admin credential on those calls. Set true only for a broker with a self-signed certificate.

rabbitmqAdminLogin.description: Optional override for the credential the RabbitMQ topology bootstrap Job uses on the management API. Empty (default): the Job uses the application's broker credential, secrets.RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER / RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS, delivered in a dedicated PreSync Secret. No path renders a credential as an inline value in the Job manifest.

name.description: Name of an existing Secret containing the fixed keys RABBITMQ_ADMIN_USER and RABBITMQ_ADMIN_PASS. When set, the chart emits no Secret of its own; username and password must be left empty.

username.description: Admin username. Set username AND password together to override the application's broker credential; a half-declared override fails the render. Mutually exclusive with useExistingSecret.name.

password.description: Admin password. Set together with username; see username. Mutually exclusive with useExistingSecret.name.

aws.description: AWS Authentication - IAM Roles Anywhere for non-AWS clusters (e.g. Clotilde/Proxmox)
